span.strong: twenty-seven years on the same corner

div.p: Victoria opened in two rooms above a florist, with one vet and a borrowed X-ray machine. Today we're nine vets and nurses in a purpose-built centre a hundred meters down the road — and we still know most of our patients by name.
We stayed independent on purpose. We choose our own equipment, we're never rushed through a consult, and the person who diagnoses your pet is the person who follows up.

p.strong: Here are some common questions about our company.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between

span.span: Are you taking on new patients?

div.p: Yes, we register new cats, dogs and small pets every week. Bring any history from your previous practice and we will request the rest for you.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

div.p: Our 24/7 line is answered by our own on-call vets, not a call centre. Out-of-hours emergencies are seen at the clinic whenever it is safe to do so.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

div.p: Dogs, cats, rabbits and small mammals. We do not see reptiles or horses, but we can refer you to a trusted local specialist.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

span.span: Do you work with pet insurance?

div.p: We work with all major UK insurers and can process direct claims for treatment over £300. We also offer a monthly health plan covering vaccinations, flea and worm treatment.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

div.p: There is metered parking on Warwick Way and a car park on Denbigh Street. Victoria station is a seven-minute walk.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

span.span: What should I bring to a first visit?

div.p: Vaccination records, any current medication, and your insurance details. Cats are happiest in a hard carrier, we have a separate feline waiting area.
